description: Find a safety data sheet (SDS) by product name or manufacturer, using the same lookup that powers SDSentry's free /sds-search page plus matching sheets already in SDSentry's shared SDS library. Returns up to 5 matches with product, manufacturer, whether the PDF is manufacturer-hosted or a third-party copy, the revision date printed on the sheet when it has been read, the SDS PDF link, a public page to view or print it, and a link to SDSentry's free, no-signup printable GHS secondary-container label maker for that product (with language "es", the best match also carries the manufacturer's own Spanish SDS link when one was found and read, never a machine translation, and the Spanish label maker) (it fills the label from the sheet when the sheet's Section 1 is confirmed; otherwise the hazard classes are ticked by hand). A product that cannot be identified reliably is reported as not found, never guessed. Read-only, free, no signup.

language.description: Optional output language. "es" adds the manufacturer's own Spanish SDS link when one was found and read, and the label elements in the official UN GHS Spanish wording. Default "en".

query.description: Product name and/or manufacturer, e.g. "WD-40" or "Clorox bleach".

name: search_sds
title: Search safety data sheets (SDS) by product or manufacturer
